useful_references.title: 2024 Putnam Session B Solutions
useful_references.complete_statement: For partners, side lengths are permuted and the sum of a pair of opposite angles is preserved; an ordered quadruple of side lengths plus that angle sum determines a convex quadrilateral up to congruence.
expanded_definitions: The preserved angle datum is the unordered pair of the two opposite-angle sums; fixing either member permits a cyclic labeling.
applicability_check: The partner reflection interchanges A and C and sends D to E, so it preserves the required side and angle data exactly.
proof_insights: Compare two law-of-cosines formulas for the common diagonal; one side is strictly increasing in one opposite angle and the other strictly decreasing.
useful_references.why_useful: It provides a concise finite-state obstruction to an infinite pairwise noncongruent sequence.
